=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3062-3067 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_drop_step_script_lines`, a bare `##[endgroup]` with no section key runs `pending = []` and discards buffered unstyled lines, such as output inside a user-defined `Run ...` group.
  WHY: Real failure output is lost before `_SOFT_LOG_PATTERNS` is applied, so heal evidence loses it. Severity disagreement: sonnet=NIT, gemini=MAJOR, glm=MAJOR; highest is used (MAJOR mapped to high). Suggested fix: `if in_script: kept.extend(pending)` before `pending = []`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:614-617, 3199-3203, 3242-3252 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Extending `_SOFT_LOG_PATTERNS` (including `exited with code` lines) changes the `filter_log` output that feeds `error_signature` and the heal fingerprint, contrary to "do not change fingerprint inputs".
  WHY: A different signature or fingerprint for the same failure would split it from its existing deduplication lineage. Disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash found that production fingerprints use raw logs, not `filter_log` output.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:617 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `(?!success\b)` lookahead in `\bCLAUDE_POOL run\b.*\boutcome=(?!success\b)` keeps lines whose outcome is `successful`, `succeeded` or `succeed`.
  WHY: Spurious signal lines reach the heal evidence and signature input.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:614-619 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The greedy `.*` in the new `CLAUDE_POOL run` regex may behave unpredictably when multiple `outcome=` substrings exist.
  WHY: Filtering behavior depends on the exact log message format.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3023-3054 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `real_close` accepts any `##[endgroup]` for an unstamped header without the next-line guard.
  WHY: An unstamped `##[endgroup]` inside an env value could close the env block early. The pass-1 claim matches `_strip_step_env_values` behavior, and unstamped headers are not produced today.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1164-1175 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `test_drop_step_script_lines_keeps_uses_step_header`, the `bare` fixture never reaches the bare-close path, because the unstamped `out` line makes `real_close` false and the end-of-input flush keeps the lines.
  WHY: The test would still pass if the bare-close path regressed, so it gives false assurance.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:1127-1147 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `test_drop_step_script_lines_drops_unstyled_echoed_script`, the assertion `"\nfi" not in dropped` can never fail, because every fixture line has a timestamp prefix.
  WHY: A regression that kept the `fi` line would still pass.
- tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:66,88 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_checkout_workflows_are_all_classified` fails because the allowlist entry `propagate-consumer-secrets.yml` has no matching workflow file, which is pre-existing drift that the PR gate misattributed to this change.
  WHY: The test fails deterministically on this ref regardless of the PR diff.
- .github/workflows (copilot-pull-request-reviewer check run) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The only failed CI check-run on the head SHA is `copilot-pull-request-reviewer`, which failed with "Prompt too big after adding system message (errorCode: custom_instructions_too_large, statusCode 422)".
  WHY: The failure is environmental and unrelated to any hunk in the PR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3062-3067 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A `##[endgroup]` before any section key discards the buffered unstyled lines (`pending = []`), so a user-defined `Run ...` group loses its output.
  WHY: Output such as `FAILED test_x` or `::error::...` is lost before `_SOFT_LOG_PATTERNS` is applied. Suggested fix: `kept.extend(pending)` when `in_script` is true.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:`test_drop_step_script_lines_keeps_uses_step_header`, `bare` fixture | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unstamped trailing `out` line means the bare-header close path is never exercised.
  WHY: The test is false assurance and would pass if the bare-close branch regressed.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:`test_drop_step_script_lines_drops_unstyled_echoed_script`, assertion `"\nfi" not in dropped` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Every fixture line starts with a timestamp, so `"\nfi"` can never appear in the output.
  WHY: A regression that kept the `fi` line would still pass. Asserting on `"0000500Z fi"` would work.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: None unmet. | Expected change site: n/a | Evidence of absence: n/a | severity=NIT | confidence=1
- Hardening: flush buffered lines on a bare close (`if in_script: kept.extend(pending)`), about 3 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
